details: A failed order remains pending each next global trading open; a new month-end signal supersedes the old pending target.
Orders are whole 100 units, sells occur before buys; never borrow or allow negative cash. Each acquired lot has settlement date; sellable units exclude same-session purchases.
When target1, buy maximal affordable integer lots using raw open plus fixed slippage and commission; target0 sells all eligible holdings. No mid-month rebalance after a successful monthly order.
Benchmark starts pending target1 at first evaluation open and uses same monthly cash reinvestment logic.
Missing valuation on global sessions is a hard data failure, not forward-filled. No liquidation at terminal date. Monthly return first month uses100000 initialcapital.

Use observed broad-market calendar independent ofETF for2018-2026 alignment. Signal TR initializes arbitrary100 at first2018observed close, monthly endpoints after that have consistent scale; no January2018 complete-month return claim.
